# GOV.UK Design System patterns

Best practice solutions for specific tasks and page types. Patterns combine components and
tell you how to adapt them — this is the layer that component code alone cannot give you.

| Pattern | Also called | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |

| [Check answers](check-answers.md) |  | Let users check their answers before submitting information to a service |
| [Complete multiple tasks](complete-multiple-tasks.md) |  | Task lists help users understand tasks involved in completing a transaction, the order they should complete tasks in and when they have completed tasks |

| [Confirmation pages](confirmation-pages.md) | completion pages, receipts, finish pages | Let users know they’ve completed a transaction |
